# Epic: Marketing Site Development

## Overview
Design and implement the main marketing website that showcases the platform's features, benefits, and drives user sign-ups.

## Objectives
- Create engaging landing page
- Implement feature showcase sections
- Design responsive marketing components
- Build contact and support pages
- Implement blog/content platform
- Create customer testimonial system

## Features
1. [Landing Page](../../features/marketing/01-landing-page.md)
2. [Feature Showcase](../../features/marketing/02-feature-showcase.md)
3. [Content Management](../../features/marketing/03-content-management.md)
4. [Contact System](../../features/marketing/04-contact-system.md)
5. [Testimonials](../../features/marketing/05-testimonials.md)

## Technical Requirements
- Server-side rendering for SEO optimization
- Progressive Web App implementation
- Image optimization and lazy loading
- Analytics integration
- A/B testing capability
- Performance monitoring
- Mobile-first responsive design

## Acceptance Criteria
- Website loads in < 2 seconds
- Responsive on all major devices
- Accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1)
- Analytics tracking implemented
- All forms properly validated
- SEO meta tags properly configured
- Social sharing optimized

## Dependencies
- Core branding guidelines
- Authentication Portal Epic

## Estimate
- Story Points: 34
- Timeline: 3 weeks

## Technical Notes
- Use Rails with Hotwire for dynamic content
- Implement proper caching strategy
- Use CSS utility framework for responsive design
- Implement structured data for SEO
